source: analysis/scripts/validate.js (Phase E independent re-derivation, unchanged in Phase F)

notes.unique_properties_methodology: case/whitespace/hyphen-normalized apartment_name + exact locality/floor/bedroom + carpet_area within 5% + price within 15% + geo within 0.01deg + different source website. See INVESTIGATION_LOG.md Phase E/F.
notes.corrupt_listing_ids_categories: negative_or_zero_price, floor_exceeds_total_floors, carpet_area_exceeds_super_built_up, swapped_lat_long. The Phase C/D 'implausible sub-Rs30k price' category was removed in Phase E/F as not meeting the impossibility bar.
notes.fake_listing_ids_methodology: posted_by_contact shared across multiple posted_by_name values, where at least one name matches a real-estate agency/company brand pattern, AND price/sqft is ~44-46% below the dataset average controlling for bedroom count. See INVESTIGATION_LOG.md Phase E.
notes.avg_price_per_sqft_2bhk_methodology: mean of per-record (price / carpet_area) ratios, not total price / total area. Excludes corrupt_listing_ids and fake_listing_ids. carpet_area uses the magichomes sqm->sqft correction.
notes.costliest_project_methodology: price_max converted via the Lakh/Crore rule (raw<10 => *1e7, raw>=10 => *1e5), cross-checked against every project's actual joined listing prices; robust under the most generous alternative resolution of 3 ambiguous outlier projects.
